objective: Challenge A34 (a chain composes when its far contact binds its ends at every lag), as PATH-GROWTH-20261108-001's stop rule set out and the coordinator relayed on 2026-11-08 (G5 with G1). The alternative reads composition at the recurring lags the path itself fixes: the far contact binds the end rings at some lag of its eventual cycle, so at lags recurring with the path's period. The discriminator is transport: on PATH-GROWTH's growth families (one linear rule per ring, every law; four rings growing from 3 to 9 cells, or paths from 4 to 9 rings), is there a family that composes at recurring lags at every size, with every contact persistent, or with every contact binding at the composing lags as in INTERMITTENT-NET-20261108-001? The meaning of each outcome for A34 is pre-registered in docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md and in the contract before the census runs.
status: Complete 2026-11-08: A34 overturned by the pre-registered rule. 452 families of paths compose at recurring lags with every contact persistent at every size of their schedule (rings of 4 to 9 cells, rules 60 and 102; paths of 4 to 9 rings), while none composes at every lag at two sizes; verified independently and on full state spaces.
